subject: Copywriting
title: The Subscription Economy's Copy
description: A fast breakdown of The Subscription Economy's Copy for builders.

hook.text: Netflix, Spotify, and SaaS companies live or die by one metric: churn. Copy fights churn at every step.

buildup.text: Onboarding emails, upgrade prompts, cancellation pages—subscription copy must persuade continuously.

discovery.text: The cancel page is copy's hardest job. Companies test every word to save subscribers from leaving.

twist.text: Dark patterns also emerged—hiding cancel buttons, guilt-tripping leavers. Persuasion crossed into deception.

climax.text: The FTC now regulates cancellation flows. Copy ethics became a legal issue, not just a moral one.

punchline.text: Subscribing is one click. Canceling is a copywriter's maze.
